subject: Sync: marketplace onboarding charter & tech deep-dive — calendar alignment
body:
From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cloudharbor.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: discovery recap — next steps for marketplace intake

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Wanted to capture a couple quick notes and propose next steps so we don't lose momentum on the marketplace integration.

Highlights from our side:
- Primary use case: CloudHarbor wants to list managed integrations in the Azure/Google marketplaces for their ML platform; expecting ~2–3 models surfaced via Redwood API.
- Success metrics: onboarding within 6 weeks, <200ms P95 inference for small text completions, and clear SSO/KMS integration documentation.
- Security: CloudHarbor will need SOC2 and network peering guidance, plus an option for private deployment for regulated customers.

Requested next steps:
1) Technical deep-dive (60–75m) to align on network, auth, and packaging for marketplace listing.
2) Product/ops sync to confirm SLA expectations and billing model (consumption vs. committed).
3) Intake checklist from Redwood so CloudHarbor can gather required artifacts.

Availability: we have a few options early next week (Wed/Thu mornings PT work best). I can block a tentative Zoom if you share a preferred slot.

Attachments: I attached a short intake checklist and a sample marketplace playbook for reference.

Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Partner Lead, CloudHarbor Systems
alyssa@cloudharbor.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 16:18:12 -0700
Subject: Re: discovery recap — next steps for marketplace intake

Alyssa — great call, appreciate the clarity.

Proposed plan:
- Technical deep-dive: 60m with our infra lead + product engineer to cover auth, KV cache behavior, and packaging for marketplace images.
- Ops/pricing: 30m separate session with Ben to review billing model and SLA.

Slots I can commit to next week (PT):
- Wed May 22, 09:00–10:30
- Wed May 22, 11:00–12:00
- Thu May 23, 08:30–09:30

If any of those work, I'll send a calendar invite with Zoom and an agenda. Also tagging Camila — she’ll drive the intake checklist and will collect the artifacts Alyssa mentioned.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cloudharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: discovery recap — next steps for marketplace intake

Thanks Jonas & Alyssa. I can run point on the intake and will use the attached checklist to collect what CloudHarbor needs to prepare. A few clarifying Qs from our side so we cover them in the deep-dive:

- For SSO: do you prefer SAML or OIDC for marketplace listings? Any IdP examples we should test against?
- Do you expect to surface embeddings or only text generation endpoints initially?
- Any regulatory regions (EU/UK) we should prioritize for private deployments?

I've tentatively penciled Wed May 22, 09:00–10:00 PT in Camila & Jonas calendars. If that slot is a hard no for CloudHarbor, let me know which of Jonas' other two options works and I'll update.

Attachments: cloudharbor-intake-checklist.pdf (filled template), redwood-marketplace-playbook-v1.pdf

Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

-----Original Message-----
From: Alyssa Moore <alyssa@cloudharbor.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: discovery recap — next steps for marketplace intake

Thanks — Wed 22 09:00 PT works for our team. We’ll have our platform engineer (Ravi Patel) join to cover networking and SSO.

Quick answers to Qs:
- SSO: we generally support both OIDC and SAML; OIDC will be smoother for our managed listing flows.
- Endpoints: initially text generation only (two model endpoints), embeddings later in Q3.
- Regions: US + EU for the first pass; UK can follow in phase 2.

I’ll send a Zoom invite and add the HubSpot deal link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/4729. Our legal team asked for a sample SOW template — will include a rough draft ahead of the ops/pricing call.

Alyssa
Alyssa Moore
Partner Lead, CloudHarbor Systems
alyssa@cloudharbor.com

--
Related links: Zoom meeting (to follow), HubSpot record, DocuSign for SOW
